claims.action: had officers compile ancient Sima military methods and attach Rangju

units.zh: 司馬穰苴者，田完之苗裔也。
units.en: Sima Rangju was a descendant of Tian Wan.
units.literal: Sima Rangju was Tian Wan's descendant.

units.zh: 齊景公時，晉伐阿、甄，而燕侵河上，齊師敗績。
units.en: During the reign of Lord Jing of Qi, Jin attacked A and Zhen, while Yan invaded the lands along the river, and the Qi army suffered a defeat.
units.literal: In the time of Lord Jing of Qi, Jin attacked A and Zhen, while Yan invaded the lands along the river, and the Qi army suffered a defeat.

units.zh: 景公患之。
units.en: Lord Jing was worried about it.
units.literal: Jing Gong worried about it.

units.zh: 晏嬰乃薦田穰苴曰：「穰苴雖田氏庶孽，然其人文能附眾，武能威敵，願君試之。」
units.en: Yan Ying then recommended Tian Rangju, saying, "Though Rangju is only a minor collateral of the Tian clan, in civil affairs he can win the allegiance of the troops, and in martial affairs he can overawe the enemy. I hope Your Lordship will try him."
units.literal: Yan Ying then recommended Tian Rangju, saying: "Though Rangju is a minor collateral of the Tian clan, in civil affairs he can win the allegiance of the troops, and in martial affairs he can overawe the enemy. I hope Your Lordship will try him."

units.zh: 景公召穰苴，與語兵事，大說之，以為將軍，將兵捍燕晉之師。
units.en: Lord Jing summoned Rangju and spoke with him about military affairs. He was greatly pleased, made him general, and had him lead troops to defend against the Yan and Jin armies.
units.literal: Jing Gong summoned Rangju, spoke with him about military affairs, greatly pleased, made him general, led troops to defend against Yan and Jin armies.

units.zh: 穰苴曰：「臣素卑賤，君擢之閭伍之中，加之大夫之上，士卒未附，百姓不信，人微權輕，願得君之寵臣，國之所尊，以監軍，乃可。」
units.en: Rangju said, "I have long been lowly. Your Lordship raised me from among the common ranks and placed me above grand officers. The soldiers are not yet attached to me, the people do not yet trust me; my person is lowly and my authority light. I wish to obtain Your Lordship's favored minister, one whom the state honors, to supervise the army—only then will it do."
units.literal: Rangju said: "I have long been lowly. Your Lordship raised me from among the common ranks and placed me above grand officers. The soldiers are not yet attached, the people do not yet trust me; my person is lowly and my authority light. I wish to obtain Your Lordship's favored minister, one whom the state honors, to supervise the army—only then will it do."

units.zh: 於是景公許之，使莊賈往。
units.en: Thus, Lord Jing permitted it and sent Zhuang Jia to go.
units.literal: Thus, Jing Gong permitted it, sent Zhuang Jia to go.

units.zh: 穰苴既辭，與莊賈約曰：「旦日日中會於軍門。」
units.en: Rangju, having taken leave, made an agreement with Zhuang Jia, saying: 'Tomorrow at noon, meet at the army gate.'
units.literal: Rangju having taken leave, made agreement with Zhuang Jia saying: 'Tomorrow noon meet at army gate.'

units.zh: 穰苴先馳至軍，立表下漏待賈。
units.en: Rangju first galloped to the army camp, erected a pole, set up a water clock, and awaited Jia.
units.literal: Rangju first galloped to army, erected pole set water clock awaited Jia.

units.zh: 賈素驕貴，以為將己之軍而己為監，不甚急；
units.en: Jia was by nature arrogant and of high rank. He thought that the general would command the army while he himself was only the army supervisor, and so he was not in much of a hurry;
units.literal: Jia was by nature arrogant and of high rank; he thought that the general would command the army while he himself was only the army supervisor, and was not very urgent;

units.zh: 親戚左右送之，留飲。
units.en: His relatives and attendants sent him off, and he stayed drinking.
units.literal: relatives and attendants sent him, stayed drinking.

units.zh: 日中而賈不至。
units.en: At noon Jia had not arrived.
units.literal: At noon Jia not arrived.

units.zh: 穰苴則仆表決漏，入，行軍勒兵，申明約束。
units.en: Rangju then overturned the pole and drained the water clock, entered the camp, marched through the army and mustered the troops, and proclaimed the regulations.
units.literal: Rangju then overturned the pole and drained the water clock, entered, marched through the army and mustered the troops, and proclaimed the regulations.

units.zh: 約束既定，夕時，莊賈乃至。
units.en: The regulations having been established, at evening time Zhuang Jia then arrived.
units.literal: Regulations established, evening time, Zhuang Jia then arrived.

units.zh: 穰苴曰：「何後期為？」
units.en: Rangju said, "Why did you arrive after the appointed time?"
units.literal: Rangju said: "Why did you arrive after the appointed time?"

units.zh: 賈謝曰：「不佞大夫親戚送之，故留。」
units.en: Jia apologized, saying, "This unworthy officer's relatives saw me off, and so I stayed."
units.literal: Jia apologized, saying: "This unworthy officer's relatives saw me off, and so I stayed."

units.zh: 穰苴曰：「將受命之日則忘其家，臨軍約束則忘其親，援枹鼓之急則忘其身。
units.en: Rangju said, "On the day a general receives his command, he forgets his household; when he faces army regulations, he forgets his kin; when the drumsticks are urgently needed, he forgets his own body.
units.literal: Rangju said: "On the day a general receives his command, he forgets his household; when he faces army regulations, he forgets his kin; when the drumsticks are urgently needed, he forgets his own body.

units.zh: 今敵國深侵，邦內騷動，士卒暴露於境，君寢不安席，食不甘味，百姓之命皆懸於君，何謂相送乎！」
units.en: Now the enemy states are deeply invading, the state within is disturbed, the soldiers are exposed on the borders, the lord sleeps uneasily on his mat and eats without tasting sweetness, and the people's lives all hang on you—what do you mean by an escort!"
units.literal: Now the enemy states deeply invade, the state within is disturbed, the soldiers are exposed on the borders, the lord sleeps uneasily on his mat and eats without tasting sweetness, and the people's lives all hang on you—what do you mean by an escort!"

units.zh: 召軍正問曰：「軍法期而後至者雲何？」
units.en: He summoned the army judge and asked, "According to military law, what is done to one who arrives after the appointed time?"
units.literal: He summoned the army judge and asked, saying: "According to military law, what is done to one who arrives after the appointed time?"

units.zh: 對曰：「當斬。」
units.en: The army judge answered, "He should be beheaded."
units.literal: The army judge answered: "He should be beheaded."

units.zh: 莊賈懼，使人馳報景公，請救。
units.en: Zhuang Jia was afraid and sent men galloping to report to Lord Jing, requesting rescue.
units.literal: Zhuang Jia feared, sent men galloped to report Jing Gong, requested rescue.

units.zh: 既往，未及反，於是遂斬莊賈以徇三軍。
units.en: The messenger had already gone but not yet returned; thereupon Rangju beheaded Zhuang Jia to display the punishment before the three armies.
units.literal: The messenger had already gone but not yet returned; thereupon he beheaded Zhuang Jia to display the punishment before the three armies.

units.zh: 三軍之士皆振慄。
units.en: All the soldiers in the three armies shuddered in fear.
units.literal: The soldiers of the three armies all trembled in awe.

units.zh: 久之，景公遣使者持節赦賈，馳入軍中。
units.en: After some time, Lord Jing sent an envoy carrying his credentials of authority to pardon Jia; the envoy galloped straight into the army camp.
units.literal: After a long time, Lord Jing sent an envoy holding credentials of authority to pardon Jia, and the envoy galloped into the army camp.

units.zh: 穰苴曰：「將在軍，君令有所不受。」
units.en: Rangju said, "When the general is in the army, he is not bound to accept all the lord's commands."
units.literal: Rangju said: "When the general is in the army, he is not bound to accept all of the lord's commands."

units.zh: 問軍正曰：「馳三軍法何？」
units.en: He asked the army judge, "What does military law say about galloping through the army camp?"
units.literal: He asked the army judge: "What does military law say about galloping through the army camp?"

units.zh: 正曰：「當斬。」
units.en: The army judge said, "He should be beheaded."
units.literal: The army judge said: "He should be beheaded."

units.zh: 使者大懼。
units.en: The envoy was greatly afraid.
units.literal: Envoy greatly feared.

units.zh: 穰苴曰：「君之使不可殺之。」
units.en: Rangju said, "The lord's envoy cannot be killed."
units.literal: Rangju said: "The lord's envoy cannot be killed."

units.zh: 乃斬其仆，車之左駙，馬之左驂，以徇三軍。
units.en: Rangju then had the envoy's driver beheaded, the chariot's left upright cut off, and the team's left outside horse killed, displaying the punishment before the three armies.
units.literal: Thereupon he beheaded the envoy's driver, cut off the chariot's left upright, and killed the team's left outside horse, displaying the punishment before the three armies.

units.zh: 遣使者還報，然後行。
units.en: He sent the envoy back to report, then proceeded.
units.literal: Sent envoy back to report, then proceeded.

units.zh: 士卒次舍井灶飲食問疾醫藥，身自拊循之。
units.en: He personally oversaw the soldiers' encampments, wells, stoves, food, drink, and inquired about illnesses and medicine. He personally stroked and comforted them.
units.literal: As for the soldiers' encampments, wells, stoves, food and drink, and inquiries about illness and medicine, he personally stroked and comforted them.

units.zh: 悉取將軍之資糧享士卒，身與士卒平分糧食。
units.en: He took all the general's provisions to feast the soldiers, and personally shared the rations equally with the soldiers.
units.literal: He took all the general's provisions to feast the soldiers, and personally shared the rations equally with the soldiers.

units.zh: 最比其羸弱者，三日而後勒兵。
units.en: He waited until even the weakest men had recovered, and only after three days did he assemble and drill the troops.
units.literal: He waited until the weakest had recovered; only after three days did he muster and drill the troops.

units.zh: 病者皆求行，爭奮出為之赴戰。
units.en: Even the sick asked to march; they vied to exert themselves and go out to fight for him.
units.literal: The sick all asked to march; they vied to exert themselves and go out to fight for him.

units.zh: 晉師聞之，為罷去。
units.en: The Jin army heard of it and withdrew.
units.literal: Jin army heard it, withdrew and left.

units.zh: 燕師聞之，度水而解。
units.en: When the Yan army heard of this, it crossed back over the river and dispersed.
units.literal: The Yan army heard of it, crossed the river, and disbanded.

units.zh: 於是追擊之，遂取所亡封內故境而引兵歸。
units.en: Thus, he pursued them, then took back the lost territories within the former borders and led the troops back.
units.literal: Thus, pursued them, then took the lost sealed territories former borders and led troops back.

units.zh: 未至國，釋兵旅，解約束，誓盟而後入邑。
units.en: Not yet having reached the state, he released the troops, dissolved the regulations, swore covenants, and then entered the towns.
units.literal: Not yet reached state, released troops, dissolved regulations, swore covenant then entered towns.

units.zh: 景公與諸大夫郊迎，勞師成禮，然後反歸寢。
units.en: Lord Jing with the various grand officers welcomed them in the suburbs, rewarded the army and completed the rites, then returned to the palace.
units.literal: Jing Gong with various grand officers welcomed in suburbs, rewarded army completed rites, then returned to palace.

units.zh: 既見穰苴，尊為大司馬。
units.en: After Lord Jing had seen Rangju, he honored him as Grand Marshal.
units.literal: After he had seen Rangju, he honored him as Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 田氏日以益尊於齊。
units.en: The Tian clan day by day became increasingly honored in Qi.
units.literal: Tian clan day by day increasingly honored in Qi.

units.zh: 已而大夫鮑氏、高、國之屬害之，譖於景公。
units.en: Before long, the grand officers of the Bao, Gao, and Guo families and their faction grew jealous of him and slandered him to Lord Jing.
units.literal: Before long the grand officers of the Bao family, Gao, Guo, and their faction harmed him and slandered him to Lord Jing.

units.zh: 景公退穰苴，苴發疾而死。
units.en: Lord Jing dismissed Rangju, and Rangju fell ill and died.
units.literal: Jing Gong dismissed Rangju, Rangju fell ill and died.

units.zh: 田乞、田豹之徒由此怨高、國等。
units.en: Tian Qi, Tian Bao and their followers thus resented Gao, Guo and the others.
units.literal: Tian Qi, Tian Bao and followers thus resented Gao, Guo and others.

units.zh: 其後及田常殺簡公，盡滅高子、國子之族。
units.en: Later, when Tian Chang killed Lord Jian, he exterminated the lineages of Gaozi and Guozi completely.
units.literal: Later, when it came to Tian Chang killing Lord Jian, he completely exterminated the lineages of the Gao and Guo families.

units.zh: 至常曾孫和，因自立為齊威王，用兵行威，大放穰苴之法，而諸侯朝齊。
units.en: By the time of Tian Chang's great-grandson He, he thereupon established himself as King Wei of Qi. He employed troops and exercised authority, greatly promulgated Rangju's methods, and the feudal lords came to court Qi.
units.literal: By the time of Tian Chang's great-grandson He, he thereupon established himself as King Wei of Qi; he employed troops and exercised authority, greatly promulgated Rangju's methods, and the feudal lords came to court Qi.

units.zh: 齊威王使大夫追論古者司馬兵法而附穰苴於其中，因號曰司馬穰苴兵法。
units.en: Qi King Wei sent grand officers to trace and discuss the ancient Sima military methods and attached Rangju within them, thus naming them the Sima Rangju Military Methods.
units.literal: Qi Wei Wang sent grand officers to trace and discuss ancient Sima military methods and attached Rangju within them, thus named Sima Rangju Military Methods.

units.zh: 太史公曰：余讀司馬兵法，閎廓深遠，雖三代征伐，未能竟其義，如其文也，亦少褒矣。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: I have read the Sima Military Methods. They are vast, profound, and far-reaching; even the campaigns of the Three Dynasties could not exhaust their principles. As for the writing itself, however, there is little to praise.
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: I have read the Sima Military Methods—vast, profound, and far-reaching. Even the campaigns of the Three Dynasties could not exhaust their principles; as for their literary style, there is also little to commend.

units.zh: 若夫穰苴，區區為小國行師，何暇及司馬兵法之揖讓乎？
units.en: As for Rangju, he merely led campaigns for a small state; how could he have had leisure to reach the ritual courtesies described in the Sima Military Methods?
units.literal: As for Rangju, merely conducting campaigns for a small state—what leisure had he to attain the ritual courtesies of the Sima Military Methods?

units.zh: 世既多司馬兵法，以故不論，著穰苴之列傳焉。
units.en: Since the world already has many discussions of the Sima Military Methods, I do not treat them here, but have written Rangju's biography.
units.literal: The world already has many discussions of the Sima Military Methods; for that reason I do not treat them here, and have set forth Rangju's hereditary biography.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 田常篡齊，六卿分晉，並為戰國，此民之始苦也。
units.en: Tian Chang seized Qi, six noble clans carved up Jin, and the age of the Warring States began—the first great wave of misery for the common people.
units.literal: Tian Chang usurped Qi, the six ministers divided Jin, and together they became the Warring States—this was the beginning of the people's suffering.

units.zh: 晏嬰相景公，食不重肉，妾不衣絲，齊國亦治，亦下比於民。
units.en: Yan Ying served Duke Jing on a single meat dish and would not dress his concubines in silk, yet Qi was well governed—he pressed himself down to the people's level.
units.literal: Yan Ying served Duke Jing of Qi; he did not have double portions of meat at meals, his concubines did not wear silk, yet the state of Qi was also well ordered—this was also downward comparison with the people.

units.zh: 為內史數年，遷御史大夫。
units.en: After some years as metropolitan superintendent he rose to imperial counselor.
units.literal: Having been Metropolitan Superintendent for several years, he was promoted to imperial counselor.

units.zh: 出公輒四年，齊田乞弒其君孺子。
units.en: In the fourth year of Duke Chu Zhe's reign, Tian Qi of Qi assassinated their lord Duke Ru.
units.literal: In Duke Chu Zhe's fourth year, Qi's Tian Qi assassinated their lord Duke Ru.

units.zh: 頗愛史書，每讀《穰苴》、《樂毅傳》，輒放卷歎息曰：「丈夫當如是！」
units.en: He loved history; reading the Records of Rang Ju and the Biography of Yue Yi, he would close the scroll and sigh, "A man should be like this!"
units.literal: He quite loved historical writings; whenever he read the Records of Rang Ju and the Biography of Yue Yi, he would put down the scroll and sigh: "A man should be like this!"
